items.title: Consumer Complaints Must Lead to Real Solutions, PURA Deputy Chief Says at 9th Consumer Parliament
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe The Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) has reaffirmed its commitment to consumer protection, transparency, and accountability, emphasizing that every consumer complaint deserves attention as the regulatory body convened its ninth Consumer Parliament ove...
